tool.name: Haddock3PassiveFromActive
tool.description: : Wrapper class for the Haddock3-Restraints passive_from_active module.

param.name: input_pdb_path
param.label: input PDB file
param.help: Path to the input PDB structure file. Format: [input].pdb

param.name: input_active_list_path
param.label: input TXT,DAT,LIST file
param.help: Path to the input file with list of active residues. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_actpass_path
param.label: output TXT,DAT,LIST,OUT name
param.help: Path to the output file with list of passive residues Format: [output].[format]

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: active_list
param.label: active_list
param.help: List of active residues as a comma-separated string. Required if input_active_list_path is not provided.

param.name: chain_id
param.label: chain_id
param.help: Chain ID to consider when calculating passive residues.

param.name: surface_list_path
param.label: surface_list_path
param.help: Path to file with list of surface residues to filter.

param.name: radius
param.label: radius
param.help: Radius in Angstroms to look for surface residues around active ones.

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the haddock3-restraints executable binary.
